title: Signal Locked
style: Epic hip-hop storytelling with cinematic anthem energy, 96 BPM half-time swing and booming toms; intro starts spoken and low, verse rides sparse kick, bass, and tense string pulses; pre-chorus opens with stacked chants and handclaps; chorus hits with world percussion, brass swells, and crowd-sized doubles. Lead vocal stays gritty and close-mic in verses, wider on hooks with ad-lib throws. Risers, reversed cymbal swells, and sub drops mark transitions. Wide, polished, chest-thumping mix., bright, light, rhythmic, industrial, world, rapid, hip-hop, clean, low
